ai_summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) has approved a Rs. 65 Crore equity investment in its 50:50 joint venture, NTPC BHEL Power Projects Private Limited (NBPPL), explicitly to settle urgent liabilities and ensure its continuation as a going concern. This material cash injection highlights NBPPL's severe financial distress, evidenced by a dramatic decline in turnover from Rs. 18.19 Crore to just Rs. 1.04 Crore over the past three years, indicating a failing venture that is now a significant financial drain on BHEL.
